about: Does a job's start get a line of Tex's own (`say`) or only a tapback? Held-out cases for the front door's job-start examples (`src/agent/jobStart.js`), never the same chats as the examples. Every case starts a job; the bench asks only what Tex says as it does. `want: line` needs a line (they'd otherwise be left guessing); `want: tap` is better as a tapback (a line would be noise). Names and details are made up. "You" is Tex.
